pe2:17.4: tattha yo ca tamo yo ca tamaparāyano, ayaṃ saṃkileso.
pe2:17.5: yo ca joti, yo ca jotiparāyano, ayaṃ vāsanā. (6)
pe2:18.1: tattha katamaṃ saṃkilesabhāgiyaṃ ca nibbedhabhāgiyaṃ ca suttaṃ:
pe2:20.1: etaṃ daḷhaṃ bandhanamāhu dhīrā ohārinaṃ sithilaṃ duppamuñcaṃ, etampi chetvāna paribbajanti anapekkhino kāmasukhaṃ pahāya. “na taṃ daḷhaṃ bandhanamāhu dhīrā …pe… puttesu dāresu ca yā apekkhā” ayaṃ saṃkileso.
pe2:20.2: “etampi chetvāna paribbajanti anapekkhino kāmasukhaṃ pahāyā”ti ayaṃ nibbedho.
pe2:20.3: “yaṃ cetayitaṃ pakappitaṃ anusayitaṃ yā ca nāmarūpassa avakkanti hoti”,
pe2:21.1: tattha katamaṃ saṃkilesabhāgiyaṃ ca nibbedhabhāgiyaṃ ca asekhabhāgiyaṃ ca suttaṃ:
pe2:24.1: ye hi keci samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā bhavena bhavassa vippamokkhamāhaṃsu, sabbe te avippamuttā bhavasmā’ti vadāmi.
pe2:24.2: ye vā pana keci samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā vibhavena bhavassa nissaraṇamāhaṃsu, sabbe te anissaṭā bhavasmā’ti vadāmi,
pe2:24.3: upadhī hi paṭicca dukkhamidaṃ sambhoti. sabbūpādānakkhayā natthi dukkhassa sambhavo, lokamimaṃ passa, puthu avijjāya paretaṃ bhūtaṃ bhūtarataṃ bhavā aparimuttaṃ.
pe2:24.4: ye hi keci bhavā sabbadhi sabbattatāya, sabbe te bhavā aniccā dukkhā vipariṇāmadhammā’ti.
pe2:28.1: (yaṃ punaggahaṇaṃ) ye hi keci samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā bhavena bhavassa vippamokkhamāṃhasu. sabbe te avimuttā bhavasmā’ti vadāmi,
pe2:28.2: ye vā pana keci samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā vibhavena bhavassa nissaraṇamāhaṃsu, sabbe te anissaṭā bhavasmā’ti vadāmi.
pe2:28.3: ayaṃ diṭṭhisaṃkileso. taṃ diṭṭhisaṃkileso ca taṇhāsaṃkileso ca ubhayametaṃ saṃkilesabhāgiyaṃ.
pe2:28.4: (yaṃ punaggahaṇaṃ) bhavavippahānāya kho panidaṃ brahmacariyaṃ vussati.” yāva “sabbupādānakkhayā natthi dukkhassa sambhavo” “sabbaso taṇhānaṃ khayā asesavirāganirodho nibbānaṃ.” idaṃ nibbedhabhāgiyaṃ.
pe2:28.5: “tassa nibbutassa bhikkhuno” yāva “upaccagā sabbabhavāni tādī”ti idaṃ asekhabhāgiyaṃ.
pe2:28.6: “cattāro puggalā: anusotagāmī saṃkileso, ṭhitatto ca paṭisotagāmī ca nibbedho,
pe2:29.1: tattha katamaṃ vāsanābhāgiyaṃ ca nibbedhabhāgiyaṃ ca suttaṃ:
pe2:31.1: “dadato puññaṃ pavaḍḍhati saṃyamato veraṃ na cīyatī” ti vāsanā,
pe2:31.2: kusalo ca jahāti pāpakaṃ rāgadosamohakkhayā sa nibbuto”ti nibbedho.
pe2:32.1: “sotānudhatesu dhammesu vacasā paricitesu manasānupekkhitesu diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhesu pañcānisaṃsā pāṭikaṅkhā:
pe2:32.2: idhekaccassa bahussutā dhammā honti dhatā vacasā paricitā manasānupekkhitā diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhā, so yuñjanto ghaṭento vāyamanto. diṭṭheva dhamme visesaṃ pappoti.
pe2:32.3: no ca diṭṭheva dhamme visesaṃ pappoti, gilāno pappoti,
pe2:32.4: no ce gilāno pappoti, maraṇakālasamaye pappoti.
pe2:32.5: no ce maraṇakālasamaye pappoti, devabhūto pāpuṇāti.
pe2:32.6: no ce devabhūto pāpuṇāti, tena dhammarāgena tāya dhammanandiyā paccekabodhiṃ pāpuṇāti.
pe2:33.1: tattha yaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme pāpuṇāti, ayaṃ nibbedho.
pe2:33.2: yaṃ samparāye paccekabodhiṃ pāpuṇāti, ayaṃ vāsanā.
pe2:33.3: imāni soḷasa suttāni sabbasāsanaṃ atigaṇhanto tiṭṭhanti.
pe2:33.4: imehi soḷasahi suttehi navavīdho suttanto vibhatto bhavati.
pe2:33.5: so ca paññavato no duppaññassa, yuttassa no ayuttassa, akammassa vihārissa. pakatiyā loko saṃkileso carati.
pe2:33.8: tato saṃkilesato uṭṭhahanto saṃkilesadhammesu patiṭṭhahati lokiyesu patiṭṭhahatīti,
pe2:33.9: tatthākusalo diṭṭhito sace taṃ sīlaṃ ca diṭṭhiṃ ca parāmasati, tassa so taṇhāsaṃkileso hoti.
pe2:33.10: sace panassa evaṃ hoti: ‘iminā’haṃ sīlena vā vatena vā tapena vā brahmacariyena vā devo vā bhavissāmi. devaññataro vā’ti, sāssa. hoti micchādiṭṭhi, so tassa micchādiṭṭhisaṃkileso bhavati.
pe2:33.11: sace pana sīle patiṭṭhito aparāmaṭṭhassa hi sīlavataṃ hoti, tassa taṃ sīlavataṃ yoniso gahitaṃ avippaṭisāraṃ janeti, (yāva-vimuttiñāṇadassanaṃ) taṃ ca tassa diṭṭheva dhamme, kālakatassa vā tamhiyeva vā pana aparāpariyāye vā aññesu khandhesu evaṃ sutaṃ: ‘sucaritaṃ vāsanāya saṃvattatī’ti vāsanābhāgiyaṃ suttaṃ vuccati.
pe2:33.12: tattha sīlesu ṭhitassapi nīvaraṇacittaṃ, taṃ tato sakkāyadiṭṭhippahānāya bhagavā dhammaṃ deseti,
pe2:33.14: yadi vā sāsanantare accantaniṭṭhaṃ nibbānaṃ pāpuṇāti, yadi vā ekāsane cha abhiñño.
pe2:33.15: tattha dve puggalā ariyadhamme pāpuṇanti; saddhānusārī ca dhammānusārī ca.
pe2:33.21: tattha yo ca ugghaṭitaññū mudindriyo, yo ca neyyo tikkhindriyo, ime puggalā asamindriyā honti.
pe2:33.22: tattha ime puggalā samindriyā parihāyanti ca ugghaṭitaññuto, vipañcitaññū neyyato, ime majjhimā bhūmigatā vipañcitaññū honti.
pe2:34.1: tattha catutthā pana pañcamā ugghaṭitaññū vipañcitaññū neyyo ca. tattha ugghaṭitaññū puggalo indriyāni paṭilabhitvā dassanabhūmiyaṃ ṭhito sotāpattiphalaṃ ca pāpuṇāti ekabījī hoti paṭhamo sotāpanno.
pe2:34.2: tattha vipañcitaññū puggalo indriyāni paṭilabhitvā dassanabhūmiyaṃ ṭhito sotāpattiphalaṃ ca pāpuṇāti, kolaṃkolo ca hoti dutiyo sotāpanno. tattha neyye puggalo indriyāni paṭilabhitvā dassanabhūmiyaṃ ṭhito sotāpattiphalaṃ ca pāpuṇāti, kolaṃkolo ca hoti dutiyo sotāpanno.
pe2:34.3: tattha neyyo puggalo indriyāni paṭilabhitvā dassanabhūmiyaṃ ṭhito sotāpattiphalaṃ ca pāpuṇāti, sattakkhattuparamo ca hoti, ayaṃ tatiyo sotāpanno
pe2:34.4: ime tayo puggalā indriyavemattatāya sotāpattiphale ṭhitā.
pe2:35.1: ugghaṭitaññū ekabījī hoti. vipañcitaññū kolaṃkolo hoti, neyyo sattakkhattuparamo hoti.
pe2:35.3: sace pana taduttariṃ vāyamati, accantaniṭṭhaṃ nibbānaṃ pāpuṇāti.
pe2:35.4: tattha ugghaṭitaññū puggalo yo tikkhindriyo, te dve puggalā honti:
pe2:35.5: anāgāmiphalaṃ pāpuṇitvā antarāparinibbāyī ca upahaccapaṭinibbāyī ca,
pe2:35.6: tattha vipañcitaññū puggalo yo tikkhindriyo, te dve puggalā honti:
pe2:35.7: anāgāmiphalaṃ pāpuṇitvā asaṅkhāraparinibbāyī ca sasaṅkhāraparinibbāyī ca.
pe2:35.8: tattha neyyo anāgāmiphalaṃ pāpuṇanto uddhaṃsoto akaniṭṭhagāmī hoti. ugghaṭitaññū ca vipañcitaññū ca indriyanānattena ugghaṭitaññū puggalo tikkhindriyo antarāparinibbāyī hoti. ugghaṭitaññū mudindriyo uddhaṃsoto akaniṭṭhagāmī hoti.
pe2:35.9: ugghaṭitaññū ca vipañcitaññū ca indriyanānattena ugghaṭitaññū puggalo tikkhindriyo sasaṅkhāraparinibbāyī hoti, tikkhindriyo antarāparinibbāyī hoti, ugghaṭitaññū mudindriyo asaṅkhāraparinibbāyī hoti.
pe2:35.10: vipañcitaññū tikkhindriyo asaṅkhāraparinibbāyī hoti, vipañcitaññū mudindriyo sasaṅkhāraparinibbāyī hoti, neyyo upahaccaparinibbāyī hoti, vipañcitaññū tikkhindriyo asaṅkhāraparinibbāyī hoti,
pe2:35.11: vipañcitaññū mudindriyo sasaṅkhāraparinibbāyī hoti, neyyo uddhaṃsoto akaniṭṭhagāmī hoti,
pe2:35.12: iti pañca anāgāmino, chaṭṭho sakadāgāmī, tayo ca sotāpannāti ime nava sekkhā.
pe2:36.1: tattha ugghaṭitaññū puggalo tikkhindriyo arahattaṃ pāpuṇanto dve puggalā honti: ubhatobhāgavimutto paññāvimutto ca.
pe2:36.2: tattha ugghaṭitaññū puggalo mudindriyo arahattaṃ pāpuṇanto dve puggalā honti: ṭhītakappī ca paṭivedhanabhāvo ca.
pe2:36.3: tattha vipañcitaññū puggalo ca tikkhindriyo arahattaṃ pāpuṇanto dve puggalā honti: cetanābhabbo ca rakkhaṇabhabbo ca.
pe2:36.4: tattha vipañcitaññū mudindriyo arahattaṃ pāpuṇanto dve puggalā honti: sace ceteti na parinibbāti,
pe2:36.6: tattha neyyo puggalo bhāvanānuyogamanuyutto parihānadhammo hoti kammaniyato vā samasīsī vā. ime nava arahanto. idaṃ catubbidhaṃ suttaṃ: saṃkilesabhāgiyaṃ …pe… asekhabhāgiyaṃ.
pe2:36.7: imesu puggalesu tathāgatassa dasavidhaṃ balaṃ pavattati.
pe2:37.2: idha buddhānaṃ bhagavantānaṃ appavattite dhammacakke mahesakkhā devaputtā yācanāya abhiyātā honti: ‘desetu sugato dhamma’nti.
pe2:37.3: so anuttarena buddhacakkhunā volokento addasāsi sattānaṃ tayo rāsī: sammattaniyato micchattaniyato aniyato.
pe2:37.4: tattha sammattaniyato rāsi micchāsatiṃ āpajjeyyāti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati, asatthuko parinibbāyeyyāti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati, samāpattiṃ āpajjeyyāti ṭhānametaṃ vijjati.
pe2:37.5: tattha micchattaniyato rāsi ariyasamāpattiṃ paṭipajjissatīti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati, anariyamicchāpaṭipattiṃ paṭipajjissatīti ṭhānametaṃ vijjati.
pe2:37.6: tattha aniyato rāsi sammāpaṭipajjamāno sammattaniyatarāsiṃ gamissatīti ṭhānametaṃ vijjati, micchāpaṭipajjamāno sammattaniyatarāsiṃ gamissatīti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
pe2:37.7: sammāpaṭipajjamāno micchattaniyatarāsiṃ gamissatīti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati, micchāpaṭipajjamāno micchattaniyatarāsiṃ gamissatīti ṭhānametaṃ vijjati.
pe2:37.8: ime tayo anuttarena buddhacakkhunā volokentassa sammāsambuddhassa me sato ‘ime dhammā anabhisambuddhā’ti ettāvatā maṃ koci sahadhammena paṭicodessatīti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati, vītarāgassa me paṭijānato akhīṇāsavatāya sahadhammena koci paṭicodessatīti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
pe2:37.9: yato pana imassa aniyatassa rāsissa dhammadesanā, sā na dissati takkarassa sammādukkhakkhayāyā’ti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati, tathā ovadito yaṃ pana me aniyatarāsi sāvako pubbenāparaṃ visesaṃ na sacchikarissatīti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
pe2:38.1: yaṃ kho muni nānappakārena nānāniruttiyo devanāgayakkhānaṃ deseti dameti, dhamme vavatthānena vatvā kāraṇato aññaṃ kāraṇaṃ gamissatīti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati,
pe2:38.3: yato panimā niruttito satta sutta (?) niruttiyo nābhisambhuneyyāti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati,
pe2:38.5: nirutti kho pana abhisamayaratānaṃ sāvakānaṃ tamatthamaviññāpayeti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
pe2:38.8: kāyikena vā mānasikena vā paripīḷitassa; hatthakuṇīti vā pāde vā khañjassa dandhassa vā, so attho na parābhājīyatīti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
pe2:38.10: yaṃ hi saṃ tesaṃ hoti taṃ hi asantaṃ bhavatīti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
pe2:38.11: yaṃ hi nasaṃ tesaṃ na bhavati, taṃ hi nasaṃ tesaṃ bhavissatīti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
pe2:38.13: māro vā indo vā brahmā vā tathāgato vā cakkavattī vā so vata nāma mātugāmo bhavissatīti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati, puriso rājā cakkavattī sakko devānamindo bhavissatīti ṭhānametaṃ vijjati.
pe2:38.14: itissa evarūpaṃ balaṃ evarūpaṃ ñāṇaṃ, idaṃ vuccati ṭhānāṭhānañāṇaṃ paṭhamaṃ tathāgatabalaṃ. taṃ niddisitabbaṃ:
pe2:38.15: tīhi rāsīhi catūhi vesārajjehi catūhi paṭisambhidāhi, paṭiccasamuppādassa pavattiyaṃ nivattiyaṃ bhāgiyaṃ ca,
pe2:38.16: kusalaṃ kusalavipākesu ca upapajjati yaṃ ca itthipurisānaṃ.
pe2:38.17: idaṃ paṭhamaṃ tathāgatabalaṃ. tathāgato evaṃ jānāti:
pe2:39.1: yesaṃ pana sammattaniyato rāsi. nāyaṃ sabbatthagāminī paṭipadā, nibbānagāminiyevāyaṃ paṭipadā,
pe2:39.2: tattha siyā micchattaniyato rāsi, esā’pi na sabbatthagāminī paṭipadā,
pe2:39.3: sakkāyasamudayagāminīyevāyaṃ paṭipadā, hotu, ayaṃ tattha tattha paṭipattiyā ṭhito gacchati nibbānaṃ, gacchati apāyaṃ, gacchati devamanussassa.
pe2:39.4: yaṃ yaṃ vā paṭipadaṃ paṭipajjeyya sabbattha gaccheyya. ayaṃ sabbatthagāminī paṭipadā,
pe2:39.5: yaṃ ettha ñāṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ, idaṃ vuccati sabbatthagāminipaṭipadā ñāṇaṃ. idaṃ dutiyaṃ tathāgatabalaṃ.
pe2:40.1: sā kho panāyaṃ sabbatthagāminī paṭipadā nānādhimuttā keci kāmesu keci dukkarakāriyaṃ keci attakilamathānuyogamanuyuttā keci saṃsārena suddhiṃ paccenti keci anavajjabhāvanāyāti.
pe2:40.2: tena tena caritena vinibaddhānaṃ sattānaṃ yaṃ ñāṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ nānāgataṃ lokassa anekādhimuttigataṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
pe2:41.1: tattha sattānaṃ adhimuttā bhavanti āsevanti bhāventi bahulīkaronti.
pe2:41.4: katarā panesā dhātu: nekkhammadhātu baladhātu kāci sammattaṃ kāci micchattaṃ ca dhātu adhimuttā bhavanti
pe2:41.6: te tadeva ṭhānaṃ jāti jarāmaraṇassa abhinivissa voharanti: ‘idameva saccaṃ moghamañña’nti,
pe2:42.1: tattha yaṃ yadeva dhātuṃ seṭṭhanti, taṃ taṃ kāyena ca vācāya ca ārabhanti cetasiko
pe2:42.2: ārambho cetanā kammaṃ, kāyiko vācasiko ārambho vetasikattā kammantaraṃ. tathāgato evaṃ pajānāti: ‘iminā satthena evaṃ dhātukena evarūpaṃ kammaṃ kataṃ, taṃ atītamaddhānaṃ. iminā hetunā tassa evarūpo vipāko vipaccati etarahi, vipaccissati vā anāgatamaddhāna’nti.
pe2:42.3: evaṃ paccuppannamaddhānaṃ pajānāti: ayaṃ puggalo evaṃdhātuko idaṃ kammaṃ karoti,
pe2:42.4: taṇhāya ca diṭṭhiyā ca. iminā hetunā na tassa vipāko diṭṭhe vā dhamme, nibbattissati upapajje vā aparamhi vā pariyāyeti. evaṃ pajānāti: ‘ayaṃ puggalo evarūpaṃ kammaṃ karissati anāgatamaddhānaṃ iminā hetunā tassa evarūpo vipāko nibbattissati iminā hetunā’ti yāni cattāri kammaṭṭhānāni, idaṃ kammaṭṭhānaṃ paccuppannasukhaṃ āyatiṃ ca sukhavipākaṃ …pe…
pe2:42.5: iti ayaṃ atītānāgatapaccuppannānaṃ kammasamādānānaṃ hetuso ṭhānaso vipākavemattataṃ pajānāti uccāvacataṃ hinappaṇītataṃ. idaṃ vuccati kammavipākañāṇaṃ pañcamaṃ tathāgatabalaṃ.
pe2:43.1: tathā sattā yaṃ vā kammasamādānaṃ samādiyantā. tattha evaṃ pajānāti: imassa puggalassa kammādhimuttassa rāgacaritassa nekkhammadhātu pāripūriṃ gacchati tassa rāgānugate yuñjamānassa paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ saṃkilissati, sace puna uttariṃ vāyamato jhānavodānagate mānase visesabhāgiyaṃ paṭipadaṃ anuyuñjiyati,
pe2:43.2: tassa hi jhānabhāgiyaṃyeva paṭhamajjhāne ṭhitassa dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ vodānaṃ gacchati, tatiyaṃ ca jhānaṃ samāpajjitukāmassa somanassindriyaṃ cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati tassa sā pīti avisesabhāgiyaṃ tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ. ādissa tiṭṭhati,
pe2:43.4: tathā bhūtassa catutthaṃ jhānaṃ vodānaṃ gacchatiyeva. catutthassa jhānassa hānabhāgiyā dhammā, te ca dhammā yattha pajāyanti yehi catutthaṃ jhānaṃ vodānaṃ dissati.
pe2:43.5: evaṃ ajjhāsayasamāpattiyā yā catasso samāpattiyo tīṇi vimokkhamukhāni aṭṭha vimokkhā. jhānānīti cattāri jhānāni, vimokkhāti
pe2:43.6: aṭṭha ca vimokkhā tīṇi ca vimokkhamukhāni.
pe2:43.9: samāpattiyoti catasso ajjhāsayasamāpattiyo iti imesaṃ jhānānaṃ vimokkhasamāpattīti evarūpo saṃkileso rāgacaritassa puggalassa
pe2:43.10: evaṃ dosacaritassa, mohacaritassa, rāgacaritassa puggalassa evarūpaṃ vodānaṃ. iti yaṃ ettha ñāṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ asādhāraṇaṃ sabbasattehi.
pe2:44.1: tattha tathāgato evaṃ pajānāti: lokikā dhammā lokuttarā dhammā bhāvanābhāgiyaṃ indriyanāmaṃ labhanti
pe2:44.2: ādhipateyyabhūmiṃ upādāya, balanāmaṃ labhanti thāmagataṃ mano manindriyaṃ, taṃ upādāya,
pe2:44.4: itissa evarūpaṃ ñāṇaṃ imehi ca dhammehi ime puggalā samannāgatātipi. dhammadesanaṃ akāsi.
pe2:44.5: ākārato ca vokārato ca āsayajjhāsayassa adhimuttisamannāgatānaṃ.
pe2:44.6: idaṃ vuccati parasattānaṃ parapuggalānaṃ indriyabalaviriyavemattataṃ ñāṇaṃ sattamaṃ tathāgatabalaṃ.
pe2:45.1: tattha ca tathāgato lokādisu ca bhūmīsu saṃyojanānaṃ ca sekkhānaṃ dvīhi balehi gatiṃ pajānāti. pubbenivāsānussatiyā atīte saṃsāre etarahi ca paccuppanne, dibbacakkhunā cutūpapātaṃ iti imāni dve balāni dibbacakkhuto abhinihitāni.
pe2:45.2: so atītamaddhānaṃ dibbassa cakkhuno gocaro, so etarahi satigocaro, iti attano ca paresaṃ ca pubbenivāsañāṇaṃ anekavidhaṃ nānāppakārakaṃ paccuppannamaddhānaṃ dibbena cakkhunā. imāni dve tathāgatabalāni, aṭṭhamaṃ pubbenivāso, navamaṃ dibbacakkhu.
pe2:46.1: puna caparaṃ tathāgato ariyapuggalānaṃ jhānaṃ vodānaṃ nibbedhabhāgiyaṃ pajānāti: ayaṃ puggalo iminā maggena imāya paṭipadāya āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sacchikatvā upasampajja viharatīti, iti attano ca āsavānaṃ khaye ñāṇaṃ diṭṭhekaṭṭhānaṃ catubhūmimupādāya yāva navannaṃ arahantānaṃ āsavakkhayo odhiso sekhānaṃ anodhiso arahantānaṃ.
pe2:46.2: tattha cetovimutti dvīhi āsavehi anāsavā: kāmāsavena ca bhavāsavena ca. paññāvimutti dvīhi āsavehi anāsavā: diṭṭhāsavena ca avijjāsavena ca. imāsaṃ dvinnaṃ vimuttīnaṃ yathābhūtaṃ ñāṇaṃ, idaṃ vuccati āsavakkhaye ñāṇaṃ.
pe2:47.1: imesu dasasu balesu ṭhito tathāgato pañcavidhaṃ sāsanaṃ deseti: saṃkilesabhāgiyaṃ vāsanābhāgiyaṃ dassanabhāgiyaṃ bhāvanābhāgiyaṃ asekhabhāgiyaṃ.
pe2:47.2: tattha yo taṇhāsaṃkileso imassa alobho nissaraṇaṃ.
pe2:47.4: yo duccaritasaṃkileso imassa tīṇi kusalāni nissaraṇaṃ.
pe2:47.8: tattha abhijjhā manoduccaritaṃ kāyakammaṃ upaṭṭhapeti adinnādānaṃ sabbaṃ ca tadupanibaddhaṃ vācākammaṃ upaṭṭhapeti, musāvādaṃ ca sabbavitathaṃ sabbaṃ vācamabhāvaṃ sabbamakkhaṃ palāsaṃ abhijjhāakusalamūlanti. musāvādo adinnādānaṃ abhijjhāya cetanā. tattha vyāpādo manoduccaritaṃ kāyakammaṃ upaṭṭhapeti pāṇātipātaṃ sabbaṃ cetaṃ ākaḍḍhanaṃ parikaḍḍhanaṃ nibandhaṃ rocanaṃ, vācākammaṃ upaṭṭhapeti pisunāvācaṃ, pharusāvācaṃ. micchādiṭṭhi manoduccaritaṃ ca abhijjhaṃ vyāpādaṃ micchādiṭṭhiṃ payojeti. yassa yo koci micchādiṭṭhi cāgo rāgajo vā dosajo vā sabbaso micchādiṭṭhisambhuto, iminā kāraṇena micchādiṭṭhi kāyakammaṃ upaṭṭhapeti kāmesumicchācāraṃ, vacīkammaṃ upaṭṭhapeti samphappalāpaṃ.
pe2:48.5: tesu gahitesu tīsu akusalamūlesu dasavidhaṃ akusalaṃ pāripūriṃ gacchati. tassa tividhassa duccaritasaṃkilesassa vāsanābhāgiyaṃ ca suttaṃ nissaraṇaṃ.
pe2:48.6: tattha yo bahusito niddeso yathā lobho doso, mohopi tattha asito ettha lobho ussado. tena kāraṇena tesu vā dhammesu lobho paññāpīyati.
pe2:48.7: tatthāyaṃ moho akusalaṃ, ayaṃ avijjā, yā catubbidhā rūpe abhiniviṭṭhā, rūpaṃ attato samanupassati avijjāgato, rūpavantaṃ vā attānaṃ attani vā rūpaṃ rūpasmiṃ vā attānaṃ.
pe2:48.8: tattha katamaṃ padaṃ sakkāyadiṭṭhiyā ucchedaṃ vadati: ‘taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīra’nti natthikadiṭṭhi, adhiccasamuppannadiṭṭhi ca, añño va karoti añño paṭisaṃvediyati
pe2:48.9: pacchimasaṭṭhikappānaṃ [?] tīṇi padāni sakkāyadiṭṭhiyā sassataṃ bhajanti aññaṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīra’nti akiriyaṃ ca taṃ dukkhamicchato: ahetukaṃ ca patanti anajjhābhāvo ca kammānaṃ sabbaṃ ca mānati.
pe2:48.10: tattha ‘idameva saccaṃ moghamañña’nti saṃsārena suddhi ājīvakā chaḷāsīti paññāpenti.
pe2:48.11: yathā rūpe sakkāyadiṭṭhiyā catuvatthukā, evaṃ pañcasu khandhesu vīsativatthukā sakkāyadiṭṭhi sassataṃ bhajati.
pe2:48.12: aññājīvakā ca sassatavādikā ca sīlabbataṃ bhajanti parāmasanti iminā bhavissāmi devo vā devaññataro vātī. ayaṃ sīlabbataparāmāso.
pe2:48.13: tattha sakkāyadiṭṭhiyā so rūpaṃ attato samanupassati: taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīrami’ti. taṃ kaṅkhati vicikicchati nādhimuccati nābhippasīdati, pubbante aparante pubbantāparante …pe…
pe2:49.1: tattha saddhindriyena sabbaṃ vicikicchitaṃ pajahati, paññindriyena udayabbayaṃ passati, samādhindriyena cittaṃ ekodikaroti, viriyindriyena ārabhati
pe2:49.2: so imehi pañcahi indriyehi saddhānusārī aveccappasāde nirato ānantariyaṃ samādhiṃ uppādeti.
pe2:49.3: indriyehi suddhehi dhammānusārī appaccayatāya ānantariyaṃ samādhiṃ uppādeti,
pe2:49.6: tassa pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ tīṇi saṃyojanānā dassanā pahātabbāni sabbena sabbaṃ pahīnāni dve puggalakatāni [?]

pe2:49.8: tattha tesu abhijjhāvyāpādesu tanukatesu cha bhavā parikkhayaṃ mariyādaṃ gacchanti, dve bhavā avasiṭṭhā.
pe2:49.9: tassa abhijjhā ca byāpādo ca sabbena sabbaṃ parikkhīṇā honti.
pe2:49.12: kiñcāpi ettha aññepi cattāro kilesā rūparāgo bhavarāgo avijjā uddhaccaṃ, tetasmiṃ. mānabhūtā nappaṭibalā asmimānaṃ vinivattetuṃ, sabbepi te asmimānassa pahānaṃ ārabhante.
pe2:49.13: khīṇesu na ca tesu idamuttariṃ dassanabhūmiyaṃ pañcasu sekhapuggalesu tīsu ca paṭipannakesu dvīsu ca phalaṭṭhesu bhāvanābhāgiyaṃ suttaṃ.
pe2:49.14: taduttariṃ. asekhabhāgiya suttaṃ. katthaci bhūmi navīḷīyati [?] idaṃ
pe2:49.16: tiṇṇaṃ puggalāna desitaṃ puthujjanassa, sekhassa asekhassa. saṃkilesabhāgiyaṃ vāsanābhāgiyaṃ
pe2:49.22: taṃ ca kho saṅkhepena paññāsāya ākārehi sampatati, ye paññāsa ākārā sāsane niddiṭṭhā te saṅkhipīyantā dasahi ākārehi patanti,
pe2:49.23: ye ariyasaccaṃ nikkhepena ṭhite saṅkhipīyantā aṭṭhasu ākāresu patanti.
pe2:49.24: catusu ca sādhāraṇesu suttesu, yā hārasampātassa bhūmi te saṅkhipīyantā pañcasu suttesu patanti:
pe2:49.25: saṃkilesabhāgiye vāsanābhāgiye bhāvanābhāgiye nibbedhabhāgiye asekhabhāgiye ca.
pe2:49.28: te saṅkhipīyamānā tīsu suttesu patanti: puthujjanabhāgiye sekhabhāgiye asekhabhāgiye ca.
pe2:49.29: te saṅkhipīyantā dvīsu suttesu patanti: nibbedhabhāgiye ca pubbayogabhāgiye ca.
pe2:49.30: yathā vuttaṃ bhagavatā: “dve atthavase sampassamānā tathāgatā arahanto sammāsambuddhā dhammaṃ desenti: suttaṃ …pe…
pe2:49.31: satthā pubbayogasamannāgate appakasirena maññamāno vasiyati. pubbayogā ca bhavissanti santānaṃ maññamānādharāya [?]
pe2:49.32: tattha paññāvemattataṃ attano samanupassamānena aṭṭhavidhe suttasaṅkhepe yattha yattha sakkoti tattha tattha yojetabbaṃ,
pe2:49.33: tattha tattha yojetvā suttassa atthe niddisitabbo.
pe2:49.34: na hi sativodānaṃ manodhāretvā vinā sakkā yena kenaci suttassa atthaṃ yathābhūtaṃ niddisituṃ.

pe2:174.2: “duddasaṃ taṃ saccaṃ duddaso paṭivedho bālehi, jānato passato natthi nandī’ti vadāmi.
pe2:174.3: duddasaṃ taṃ saccaṃ duddaso paṭivedho bālehi’ti dhammādhiṭṭhānaṃ.
pe2:174.5: dārūkkhandhopamaṃ, gaṅgāya tiriyaṃ orimañca tīraṃ pārimañca tīraṃ thale vā na ca ussīdanaṃ majjhe ca na saṃsīdanaṃ manussagāho ca amanussagāho ca anto pūtibhāvo ca, idaṃ dhammādhiṭṭhānaṃ.
pe2:174.6: evaṃ pana bhikkhu nibbānaninno bhavissati nibbānapoṇo’ti sattādhiṭṭhānaṃ.
pe2:177.2: buddho sattānaṃ, virāgo dhammānaṃ, saṅgho gaṇānaṃ”
pe2:185.1: tattha katamaṃ anuññātaṃ ca paṭikkhittaṃ ca:
pe2:187.1: dvīhi paṭhamapadehi catutthena ca padena anujānāti.
